evidence: Extends JSONRPCError with a structured data field and updates rawtransaction and txoutproof RPCs and REST handlers to return missing block hashes.
rationale: Adds structured error payload handling to JSON-RPC and REST so clients can identify pruned block hashes and fetch them via getblockfrompeer. While useful for API callers interacting with pruned nodes, the interface additions directly follow from the underlying txindex feature.
